args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. The first rollback target was v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, but the rollback was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417). checkout-api was rolled back to v2.2.9, the next most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. After the rollback the service is healthy, with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and ship a fixed release that includes the CVE-2026-4417 fix. Also check whether v2.2.9 is affected by CVE-2026-4417.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to **v2.2.9** in all regions instead of v2.3.0, the release you'd expect. The system refused the rollback to v2.3.0 because that version is quarantined for a security vulnerability (CVE-2026-4417). The service is healthy now.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.2.9 is the newest release before v2.3.0 that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions, and its error rate dropped to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure, why v2.3.0 was skipped, the rollback and current health. It also lists follow-ups: find the cause of the v2.3.1 failure and ship a fixed release that includes the CVE-2026-4417 fix.

**Open question:** I don't know whether v2.2.9 also has the CVE-2026-4417 vulnerability. The quarantine only named v2.3.0, but please have someone check, since v2.2.9 is now live in production.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
v2.3.0 is quarantined for a CVE. The next most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.2.9, so I'll roll back to that.
